tools.name: google_contacts_list
tools.description: List or search the user's Google contacts. This is read-only and returns a limited page of names and email addresses. `max_results` and the number of returned rows are never exact match counts when `hasMore` is true. Never count those rows or present them as exact bulk-action totals.

max_results.description: Maximum number of contacts to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Optional name or email text used to filter contacts.
